description: This file defines the DLMClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interfacing with the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager service. It includes method signatures for operations such as creating, deleting, and managing lifecycle policies, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: DLMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) service via AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods to manage lifecycle policies.

methods.name: createLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Creates a new lifecycle policy in AWS DLM.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of lifecycle policies.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific lifecycle policy.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds or overwrites tags for a resource.
